items.title: Renew Cape Coral business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Cape Coral Business Tax
items.description: Business tax is paid annually through the city's online portal; Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30. A Lee County receipt is also needed.

items.title: Renew Clearwater business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Clearwater Business Tax
items.description: The business tax year runs October 1 to September 30 and renews annually regardless of when the receipt was obtained; late renewals add delinquent fees.

items.title: Renew Coral Springs business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Coral Springs Business Tax
items.description: Renewal payments are due September 30 each year, including home-based businesses; unpaid tax after 150 days can lead to civil action and a $250 penalty.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Davie business tax receipt
items.authority: Town of Davie Business Tax Receipt Division
items.description: Davie issues local business tax receipts for commercial, home-based, and peddler/solicitor/seasonal businesses; the town provides a receipt application and renewal portal, but the official page reviewed does not state one universal renewal date.

items.title: Obtain a Davie building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Davie Building Division
items.description: Davie requires a building permit before covered construction, alteration, repair, demolition, or a change of occupancy begins.

items.title: Obtain a Davie certificate of occupancy when required
items.authority: Town of Davie Building Division
items.description: Davie provides a certificate-of-occupancy request process for permitted construction and commercial occupancy.

items.title: Renew Fort Lauderdale business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Fort Lauderdale Business Tax
items.description: The renewal period runs July 1 through September 30 and unpaid receipts are delinquent October 1. A separate Broward County receipt is also required.

items.title: Renew Gainesville business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Gainesville Business Tax
items.description: Renewal statements are mailed in late August; payment is due October 1 and penalties accrue after that. State-regulated licenses must be on file.

items.title: Renew Hialeah business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Hialeah Business Tax
items.description: Business tax receipts cover October 1 through September 30; renewals are handled by the Business Tax Division in person, not by mail.

items.title: Renew Hollywood business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Hollywood Business Tax
items.description: Each local business tax receipt expires September 30; renewal happens during September and a receipt not renewed within 30 days after that lapses.

items.title: Renew Jacksonville local business tax receipt
items.authority: Duval County Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses operating in Jacksonville (Duval County) need a local business tax receipt; receipts run October 1 to September 30 and unpaid receipts incur a late penalty from October.

items.title: Renew Lakeland business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Lakeland Business Tax
items.description: Every business located or operating inside the city limits pays an annual business tax, based on square footage, workers and category; Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30.

items.title: Obtain and renew City of Miami Business Tax Receipt
items.authority: City of Miami
items.description: Businesses located in the City of Miami need a city business tax receipt; receipts expire September 30 each year.

items.title: Obtain and renew Miami-Dade County Local Business Tax Receipt
items.authority: Miami-Dade County Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses within a municipality must hold both the city and the county local business tax receipt; the tax year runs October 1 – September 30.

items.title: Renew Miramar business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Miramar Business Tax
items.description: Business tax receipts should be renewed on or before September 30 to avoid additional fees; bills are sent by email.

items.title: Renew City of Orlando business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Orlando Permitting Services Division
items.description: All business tax receipts expire September 30. The city sends invoices by July 1 and payment is due by October 1; penalties are 10% in October, rising monthly to 25% in January. Businesses also need an Orange County receipt.

items.title: Renew Palm Bay business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Palm Bay Business Tax
items.description: Renewal opens July 1 and covers the fiscal year October 1 through September 30; renewals are online through the city's portal.

items.title: Renew Pembroke Pines business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pembroke Pines Business Tax
items.description: The local business tax receipt is issued annually and runs October 1 through September 30; invoices and payment are online.

items.title: Renew Pompano Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pompano Beach Business Tax
items.description: Business tax receipts expire September 30; if the renewal fee is not paid by October 1 the account is delinquent and penalties apply. A Broward County receipt is separate.

items.title: Renew St. Petersburg business tax receipt
items.authority: City of St. Petersburg Business Tax Division
items.description: Businesses located within St. Petersburg city limits pay an annual business tax and hold a city business tax receipt, issued and collected by the city.

items.title: Obtain a Tallahassee building permit when required
items.authority: City of Tallahassee Growth Management
items.description: Tallahassee’s permit process requires application, plan review, payment, issuance, and inspections before covered construction or additions proceed.

items.title: Obtain a Tallahassee certificate of occupancy when required
items.authority: City of Tallahassee Growth Management
items.description: Tallahassee does not allow a building to be used or occupied until a certificate of occupancy is issued after all required inspections; a change of occupancy requires a building permit even without alterations.

items.title: Renew City of Tampa business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Tampa Business Tax
items.description: Businesses operating in Tampa hold a city business tax receipt for the fiscal year ending September 30, in addition to the Hillsborough County receipt. Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30, with a penalty from October.

items.title: Renew West Palm Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of West Palm Beach Business Tax
items.description: The tax runs on an October 1 to September 30 fiscal year; the renewal period is July 1 through September 30 and unpaid taxes are delinquent October 1 with penalties up to 25%.

items.title: Renew Port St. Lucie business tax receipt
items.authority: Port St. Lucie local licensing authority
items.description: Port St. Lucie requires every business, profession and occupation operating in the city to obtain a business tax receipt before operating; receipts renew annually from July 1 and expire September 30, with fees set by ordinance.

note: Port St. Lucie city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Miami Gardens business tax receipt
items.authority: Miami Gardens local licensing authority
items.description: Miami Gardens administers a local business license tax under Florida Statutes Chapter 205; the city revenue manual and receipt application determine the applicable classification and tax.

note: Miami Gardens city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Palm Coast business tax receipt
items.authority: Palm Coast local licensing authority
items.description: Palm Coast issues local business tax receipts for businesses operating in the city; new commercial locations must provide a certificate of occupancy, and fees are established by city council resolution.

note: Palm Coast city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Boca Raton business tax receipt
items.authority: Boca Raton local licensing authority
items.description: Boca Raton requires a Business Tax/Certificate of Use for businesses, professions and occupations; new applications are due within 15 days of tenant occupancy or the business start date, and certificates expire September 30.

note: Boca Raton city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Fort Myers business tax receipt
items.authority: Fort Myers local licensing authority
items.description: Fort Myers requires a business tax receipt before operating; annual receipts are issued July 1, renewals run July 1 through September 30, and renewal payment is due September 30.

note: Fort Myers city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Deltona business tax receipt
items.authority: Deltona local licensing authority
items.description: Deltona requires a city business tax receipt, including for home-based businesses; receipts expire September 30, renewal invoices are mailed July 1, and unpaid receipts receive a 25% penalty plus $250 surcharge starting October 1.

note: Deltona city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Plantation business tax receipt
items.authority: Plantation local licensing authority
items.description: Plantation requires a local business tax receipt before engaging in business; receipts expire September 30 and renewal payments are due between July 1 and September 30.

note: Plantation city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew Sunrise business tax receipt
items.authority: Sunrise local licensing authority
items.description: Sunrise requires a local business tax receipt for businesses operating in the city; activity-specific approvals, including food, alcohol and county business tax requirements, may also apply.

note: Sunrise city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew North Port business tax receipt
items.authority: City of North Port Economic Development Division
items.description: North Port requires a city business tax receipt; the annual fee depends on the business type, renewal information is sent before the September 30 due date, and the city provides an Accela renewal portal. Sarasota County says municipal businesses may also need to address local business-tax requirements.

items.title: Obtain the Deerfield Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Deerfield Beach Business Tax Office
items.description: Deerfield Beach requires a Certificate of Use before issuing a Business Tax Receipt. Applications are handled by the Business Tax Office; activity-specific state and county licenses may also be required, and fees depend on the business classification.

items.title: Renew Daytona Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Daytona Beach Permit & Licensing Division
items.description: Daytona Beach requires a city business tax receipt for businesses, including home-based businesses. Applicants submit the required documentation and pay the invoiced fee after approval; the city's tax year runs October 1 through September 30.

items.title: Renew Melbourne business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Melbourne Financial Services, Revenue Office
items.description: Melbourne requires a Business Tax Receipt before a business begins operating, with a separate receipt for each place of business. The initial application fee is $25 and the tax varies by business type and employees; renewals are due July 1 through September 30, with late fees beginning October 1.

items.title: Obtain a Homestead business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Homestead Business Tax Receipt Office
items.description: Homestead's Business Tax Receipt Office issues local business tax receipts to new and existing businesses. New applicants submit the receipt application, state registration documents, proof of ownership or lease, identification, and an interior layout; online payment is available for receipt accounts.

items.title: Renew Kissimmee business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Kissimmee Development Services
items.description: Kissimmee requires a city Business Tax Receipt before a business opens, and businesses inside city limits also need an Osceola County receipt. Receipts expire September 30 and must be renewed annually; the city reviews applications and may require inspections before issuance.

items.title: Renew Boynton Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Boynton Beach Development Services, Business Tax Unit
items.description: Boynton Beach requires all new businesses, including home-based businesses, to obtain a business tax receipt before commencing work. Receipts renew annually by September 30; forms and classifications are provided by the city's Business Tax Unit.

items.title: Renew Doral business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Doral Business Licensing Division
items.description: Doral requires a local business tax receipt for each place of business and separate classification. Receipts run October 1 through September 30, must be displayed with the Certificate of Use, and the city requires a separate Miami-Dade County receipt.

items.title: Renew Miami Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Miami Beach Finance Department
items.description: Miami Beach requires every business to obtain a Business License combining a Certificate of Use, annual fire fee and Business Tax Receipt. The Certificate of Use and fire inspection precede the BTR application; the city's tax year runs October 1 through September 30.

items.title: Renew Largo business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Largo Building Division
items.description: Largo requires a local Business Tax Receipt for businesses, professionals, independent contractors and individuals accepting compensation within city limits, including home businesses. Fees depend primarily on business type and square footage; receipts are due and renewed annually by September 30.

items.title: Renew Lauderhill local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Lauderhill Business Tax Office
items.description: Lauderhill requires a Certificate of Use before issuing a local Business Tax Receipt, with zoning and fire, building and code inspections as applicable. The receipt year runs October 1 through September 30; a $55.13 processing fee applies to the Certificate of Use application, and renewal penalties begin September 30 and increase monthly to 25% by January 1.

items.title: Renew St. Cloud business tax receipt
items.authority: City of St. Cloud Community Development
items.description: St. Cloud requires a Business Tax Receipt before a business opens; receipts are valid October 1 through September 30 and late renewals incur a 10% first-month penalty, 5% for each additional month up to 25%, plus a $250 final penalty after January 1. The city requires zoning, building and fire approvals before issuance.

items.title: Renew Tamarac business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Tamarac Business Revenue Division
items.description: Tamarac requires a business revenue receipt for commercial and residential businesses. Commercial applicants need zoning approval, a Certificate of Use or safety permit/certificate of occupancy and inspections before issuance; a Broward County receipt follows the city receipt, and the city provides separate online renewal for each receipt.

items.title: Renew Ocala business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Ocala Growth Management, Building Licensing
items.description: Ocala currently requires an approved Business Tax Receipt before conducting business, with annual renewals due September 30 and fees set by business type and ordinance. The city is considering an ordinance to repeal the BTR program; while that proposal is pending, the city's current BTR page says no penalties will be assessed during the stated review period.

items.title: Renew Delray Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Delray Beach Business Tax Receipts
items.description: Delray Beach requires a Business Tax Receipt before opening or establishing a business, with a separate receipt and fee for each location and classification. The standard business tax is $190.30 per type, half-year applications after April 1 are $95.15, receipts renew by September 30, and late penalties run 10%, 15%, 20% and 25% from October through January.

items.title: Renew Weston local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Weston Finance Department
items.description: Weston requires every business, including home-based businesses, to hold a Local Business Tax Receipt; a Certificate of Use is generally required first. Receipts expire September 30 and renew annually, fees vary by business type, and unpaid balances can incur penalties up to 25% plus an additional $250 or annual-tax penalty after 150 days.

items.title: Renew Sanford business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Sanford Business Tax Receipts Division
items.description: Sanford issues Business Tax Receipts for home occupations, commercial businesses and certain mobile businesses such as taxis, mobile food vendors, mobile sales and solicitors. A permit is required before a business, restaurant or commercial establishment opens, and the city verifies applicable state-agency licensing before issuance.

items.title: Renew Port Orange business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Port Orange Business Tax Office
items.description: All businesses, including home-based businesses, need a Port Orange Local Business Tax Receipt. Fees vary by classification; the receipt is renewed annually and expires September 30. State licensing is generally required before the city receipt.

items.title: Renew Apopka business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Apopka Business Tax Receipt Office
items.description: A City of Apopka Business Tax Receipt is required before operating. The city charges a $10 non-refundable application fee, classification-based fees, and renewals are due by September 30; Orange County also requires its own receipt. Late penalties are 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25%, followed after January 31 by an additional $250 plus legal fees.

items.title: Renew Palm Beach Gardens business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Palm Beach Gardens Business Services
items.description: Each business location, including home-based businesses, needs a Palm Beach Gardens Business Tax Receipt before operating. Planning and zoning, state licenses, and a commercial fire inspection may be required; the city receipt is valid through September 30 and Palm Beach County requires a separate receipt. Common application totals range from $100 for home-based businesses to $185 for a general office, depending on inspections and classification.

items.title: Renew Wellington business tax receipt
items.authority: Village of Wellington Business Tax Receipt Office
items.description: A Wellington Business Tax Receipt is required before any business, home-based business, or rental operates. Planning and zoning approval is required; Palm Beach County also requires its own receipt. Renew annually, with online renewal beginning July 1; a $250 penalty applies after 150 days delinquent.

items.title: Confirm Jupiter business tax receipt requirements
items.authority: Town of Jupiter Community Development
items.description: The Town of Jupiter states that it no longer requires a separate town business license for current and new businesses, but businesses must comply with land-development, zoning, parking, occupancy and other town requirements. Palm Beach County requires its own Local Business Tax Receipt; existing businesses renew by September 30.

items.title: Renew Winter Haven business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Winter Haven Building Division
items.description: Winter Haven issues Business Tax Receipts to all businesses and organizations within city limits. Renewal fees are due October 1 each year; zoning, fire protection and state licensing or certification should be addressed before starting, and a Polk County receipt is required with the city application.

items.title: Renew North Miami business tax receipt
items.authority: City of North Miami Office of Land Use Services
items.description: North Miami requires a Business Tax Receipt for businesses, online businesses with registered addresses, home-based businesses and independent contractors, along with a Certificate of Use where applicable. Independent contractors also need Miami-Dade County's receipt; completed applications are generally processed within 24–48 hours.

items.title: Renew Margate local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Margate Local Business Tax Receipts
items.description: Margate requires a Local Business Tax Receipt before a business or profession operates. Zoning, building and engineering review may be required, commercial life-safety inspections must pass, and renewal runs July through September 30; penalties begin October 1. Fees are full-year or half-year based on the application date.

items.title: Obtain a Coconut Creek business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Coconut Creek Development Services
items.description: Coconut Creek requires a city business tax receipt for a permanent business location or branch office. Each new application has a non-refundable $25 fee and zoning compliance must be verified before issuance; state licenses and registrations are required where applicable.

items.title: Obtain a Sarasota local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Sarasota Local Business Tax Division
items.description: Entities doing business in Sarasota must have a local business, professional or vendor tax receipt. New applicants should complete the city application, provide state registration or license documents, and pay a $50 zoning-review charge; Sarasota County repealed its business tax, but municipal receipts may still apply.

items.title: Renew Bradenton local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Bradenton Local Business Tax Desk
items.description: Anyone conducting business, an occupation or a profession within Bradenton must pay the local business tax. Fees vary by business type and classification; state requirements must be met before issuance, and annual renewals must be received by September 30 to avoid penalties.

items.title: Obtain Bonita Springs business use approval
items.authority: City of Bonita Springs Community Development
items.description: New commercial businesses, second locations, expansions, moves and ownership changes generally need a Bonita Springs Business Use Permit. Submit floor and parking plans, garbage verification, a Lee County Local Business Tax application and required inspections; after city approval, the Lee County Tax Collector collects the business tax.

items.title: Renew Pensacola business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pensacola Business Licenses
items.description: Businesses, professions and occupations within Pensacola must obtain a city Business Tax Receipt for each activity. Fees are due by September 30 each year; applicable city and Escambia County building, fire, health and zoning requirements also apply, and businesses inside city limits need both city and county receipts.

items.title: Obtain Clermont zoning and life-safety approval
items.authority: City of Clermont Building Services
items.description: Clermont repealed its city Business Tax Receipt requirement effective January 28, 2025. Commercial businesses still need zoning approval and a life-safety inspection or change-of-use permit; the published minimum cost is $152, increasing with unit square footage. Home businesses do not need the life-safety inspection.

items.title: Renew Pinellas Park business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pinellas Park Building and Planning Divisions
items.description: Pinellas Park requires a Business Tax Receipt and, for most commercial properties, a Certificate of Use. Completed applications are reviewed within five business days; fees vary by square footage, workers and business type, and all receipts expire September 30 with renewal notifications in July.

items.title: Renew Ocoee local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Ocoee Building Division
items.description: Ocoee requires a local Business Tax Receipt before operating. Fees vary by classification and units; commercial locations receive building, fire and utilities inspection, and receipts expire September 30. Late renewal penalties are 10% in October plus 5% per month thereafter, capped at 25%.

items.title: Renew Fort Pierce certificate of use
items.authority: City of Fort Pierce City Clerk
items.description: Fort Pierce discontinued city Business Tax Receipts on July 1, 2024 and requires a Certificate of Use for all businesses instead. One certificate is required per business location, it is valid for one year and renews annually on the anniversary of the initial application.

items.title: Renew Titusville business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Titusville Development Services
items.description: Titusville requires a city Business Tax Receipt after zoning compatibility and any required state license or registration are confirmed; a Brevard County receipt is required afterward. The application fee is $15 non-refundable, or $25 for a solicitors permit, and the total tax varies by business type, seats, units and square footage.

items.title: Renew Coral Gables certificate of use and business tax
items.authority: City of Coral Gables Development Services
items.description: Coral Gables requires a Certificate of Use before leasing or operating and an annual local business tax from both the city and Miami-Dade County. The Certificate of Use fee is $120; the local tax varies by classification, the tax year expires September 30, and certificates of use renew annually.

items.title: Renew Winter Garden business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Winter Garden Business Tax Office
items.description: Winter Garden requires a Business Tax Receipt before opening; the tax year runs October 1 through September 30, fees are half-year after April 1, and commercial locations may require land-use review and fire inspection. A 25% late penalty applies, and an Orange County receipt is required after the city receipt.

items.title: Renew Altamonte Springs business tax receipts
items.authority: City of Altamonte Springs City Clerk
items.description: Altamonte Springs businesses must pay both city and county business taxes; the City Clerk can collect both. State licenses must be shown before issuance, zoning review is required before approval, and new applications and annual renewals use the Civic Access system.

items.title: Renew DeLand business tax receipt
items.authority: City of DeLand Business Tax Receipts Office
items.description: All businesses located in DeLand must obtain a Business Tax Receipt and renew it annually. Renewal notices are sent by email in July, and businesses must complete an annual declaration in April when business contacts, employees, seats or stations change.

items.title: Renew North Miami Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of North Miami Beach Business Licensing Division
items.description: North Miami Beach requires a Business Tax Receipt and Miami-Dade County approval for each business use and classification. The fiscal year runs October 1 through September 30; renewal is July 1 through September 30, with penalties after October 1. Zoning approval and, for many commercial businesses, county certificate-of-use and fire approvals precede the city BTR.

items.title: Obtain a Haines City business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Haines City Building Division
items.description: Haines City issues Business Tax Receipts to commercial and residential businesses within city limits. Before applying, confirm zoning, required federal or state certifications and inspections; home businesses must also provide proof of residency at the operating location.

items.title: Renew North Lauderdale local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of North Lauderdale Community Development
items.description: North Lauderdale requires a Local Business Tax Receipt; the tax year runs October 1 through September 30 and payment is due by September 30. The initial application fee is $65, business-use inspection is $340, renewal fee is $20, and delinquency penalties are 10%, 15%, 20% and 25%, followed after 150 days by a $250 penalty.

items.title: Renew Oakland Park business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Oakland Park Business Regulatory Unit
items.description: Oakland Park requires every business to obtain a Business Tax Receipt and, for businesses other than home-based operations, a Certificate of Use before occupying or opening. Receipts renew annually online; short-term-rental and community-residence permits are valid for 365 days, and special permits may apply to massage, health spas and late alcohol service.

items.title: Obtain Cutler Bay certificate of use and business tax receipt
items.authority: Town of Cutler Bay Finance and Planning Departments
items.description: Cutler Bay requires a Certificate of Use and Local Business Tax Receipt, plus Miami-Dade County approval and receipt. The Certificate of Use fee is $35; local tax fees vary by business type, and commercial applications may require zoning, fire, site or floor plans, while home businesses need owner approval and a home-occupation affidavit.

items.title: Renew Greenacres business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Greenacres Business Tax Receipt Division
items.description: Greenacres requires a city Business Tax Receipt for every business location, including home-based businesses and residential rentals, in addition to a Palm Beach County receipt. Receipts expire September 30; late fees are 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, then a $25 collection fee plus $100 delinquent fee after 150 days. New commercial businesses pay a $75 safety-inspection fee.

items.title: Renew Ormond Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Ormond Beach Building Division
items.description: Ormond Beach requires a Business Tax Receipt before opening, plus a Volusia County receipt. The initial application fee is $30 for all business categories; commercial locations pay a $45 fire-inspection fee, and receipts are valid October 1 through September 30 with renewal notices after July 1.

items.title: Obtain a Plant City business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Plant City Business Tax Division
items.description: Plant City requires a Business Tax Receipt application with business identity, location, activity and planning-and-zoning review. Fees are determined by the business category and factors such as employees, rooms, seating, ATMs, vending machines and games; businesses also need the Hillsborough County receipt.

items.title: Obtain a Lake Worth Beach business license
items.authority: City of Lake Worth Beach Business License Division
items.description: Lake Worth Beach requires a city business license for businesses, rentals and home-based businesses. Confirm zoning and building or change-of-use requirements before leasing; home businesses also need a Home Occupation Tax Receipt and Palm Beach County application. Fees vary by classification and service type.

items.title: Obtain a Hallandale Beach local business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Hallandale Beach Business Tax and Regulations Division
items.description: Every business, profession and occupation in Hallandale Beach, including home-based businesses, must obtain a city Local Business Tax Receipt before opening. Commercial or leased locations need a zoning application; Broward County licensing may be required after the city receipt, and fees vary by classification.

items.title: Obtain a Royal Palm Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: Village of Royal Palm Beach Community Development
items.description: Royal Palm Beach requires a Village Local Business Tax Receipt and a Palm Beach County receipt. New businesses submit the tenant-inspection request, county tax form and village application; home occupations submit the county form and village application, with supporting building, fire, state-license and insurance documents when applicable.
